# NEW 2026-11-17 Roman Reconquest umbrella situation. Generated by gen_rome_reconquista.py; edit the generator, not this file.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_rr_pulse } }
oe_rr_pulse = {
    trigger = { tag = BYZ }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active }
            oe_rr_monthly = yes
        }
        # Start when the contest has ended (the end-contest action also starts it directly).
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_broken }
                NOT = { has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end }
                international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world ?= { has_variable = oe_rw_contest_ended }
            }
            oe_rr_start = { hope = 40 }
        }
        # 20 years after the dream broke: offer to rekindle it once.
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_broken NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_broken_cd } NOT = { has_variable = oe_rr_rekindle_offered } }
            set_variable = oe_rr_rekindle_offered
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_rr.40
        }
    }
}
